annotations.title: Execute a buy end to end (operator-signed, capped)

description: Buys a market for real, completing the step an LLM cannot do alone: signing the EIP-3009 USDC authorisation. IMPORTANT for honest reporting — the signature is made by the operator's wallet on the server, not by a wallet you control, so describe the result as 'executed the purchase', not 'paid from my own funds'. Refuses unless the caller carries the agent key, and refuses any quote whose asset, network, recipient or amount does not match the hard-coded limits. Delivery always goes to the signer.

chainId.description: Chain id of the market, for a ticker that trades on more than one chain (list_markets shows chainId). Without it the oldest market for that ticker is used.

symbol.description: Market ticker, for example PARCEL or ADEXTO. Required and has no default: the gateway refuses a missing ticker rather than quoting one, so a typo can never bill you for a token you did not ask for. Call list_markets first if you do not know it.

name: pay_and_buy

buyback.description: Automatic buyback result, when one ran.

delivery.description: Delivery transaction on the market's chain.

detail.description: Why it refused, or extra context on a successful answer.

error.description: Present only when the tool refused, as a stable code such as unknown_market. Nothing was spent.

gatewayError.description: The gateway's answer when it did not settle.

known.description: On unknown_market: the tickers that do exist.

limits.description: On refused_by_limits: the hard limits the quote did not meet.

paidBy.description: Operator wallet that signed the payment.

retryAfterSeconds.description: On rate_limited: seconds until the next purchase is allowed.

signedBy.description: Who signed: the operator wallet on the server, not the agent.
